description: Exact tandem repeats (e.g. ATGATGATG): every maximal run of a primitive unit of length minUnitLength..maxUnitLength with >= minRepetitions complete copies, reported once at its left end (ATATATAT = AT x4 at 0, not also ATAT x2); ordered by unit length then start; 0-based. Approximate repeats: find_approximate_tandem_repeats.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence: A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N (case-insensitive); a repeat unit must be A/C/G/T only, so windows with N never form a repeat

maxUnitLength.description: Maximum repeat-unit length (>= minUnitLength); omit for no upper bound

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Invalid DNA sequence (A/C/G/T and IUPAC codes only)
Minimum repeat-unit length must be at least 1
Maximum repeat-unit length must be at least minUnitLength

examples.name: Mononucleotide run AAAAA (unit 1) — A x5 only (AA x2 is a non-primitive tiling of the same run)
